title: Micropipette

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)
Biosafety in Microbiological and Biomedical Laboratories (BMBL)

purpose: A precision instrument for accurately measuring and transferring small liquid volumes (typically microliter to low-milliliter range) using disposable tips.
operatingPrinciple: An air-displacement piston mechanism draws a set volume of liquid into a disposable tip when the plunger is released after being pressed to the first stop, and expels it when pressed to the second (blow-out) stop.
basicOperation: Set the desired volume within the pipette's rated range — never dial beyond its minimum or maximum.
Attach a fresh, appropriately sized tip.
Press the plunger to the first stop, immerse the tip to the appropriate depth, then release slowly to draw up liquid.
Dispense by pressing to the first stop, then the second (blow-out) stop to expel the last small volume.
importantSettings: Volume setting, matched to a tip size rated for that volume range — an oversized or undersized tip affects accuracy.
calibration: Periodic gravimetric calibration (weighing dispensed volumes of water on an analytical balance) per facility schedule; pipettes drift out of calibration with heavy use and should not be assumed accurate indefinitely without checks.
maintenance: Store vertically in a rack when not in use.
Never lay a loaded pipette on its side (liquid can run into the mechanism).
Avoid dropping — a drop can knock a pipette out of calibration even if it still visibly functions.

commonErrors.cause: Wrong tip size for the set volume, inconsistent plunger technique, or a pipette overdue for calibration
commonErrors.fix: Match tip size to the volume range, use consistent slow/steady plunger technique, and calibrate on schedule

commonErrors.problem: Liquid drips from the tip after dispensing
commonErrors.cause: Plunger not pressed to the second (blow-out) stop, or a damaged tip seal
commonErrors.fix: Press fully to the blow-out stop and replace tips that don't seat properly

safety: Use a fresh tip for every new sample to prevent cross-contamination.
